name: RIVALO Design Tokens
description: Single source of truth for brand values. Mirrored by hand into mobile/lib/core/design/tokens.dart and backend/resources/css/filament/admin/theme.css. When you change a value here, update both mirrors in the same commit.

notes.accentUsage: Lime is reserved for the single primary action on a screen, active tab, selection and the V in the wordmark. Never use lime for large fills or body text on light surfaces.
notes.statusUsage: Status colors are always paired with a text label or icon. Color alone never carries meaning.
notes.textTertiary: Only for large text (>=18pt) or non-essential metadata; it meets 4.5:1 on background but not on surfaceRaised.

typography.fontFamily: Platform system font (SF Pro on iOS/macOS, Roboto on Android, system-ui on web). No downloaded web fonts.
typography.notes: Scale follows the Apple Human Interface Guidelines default Dynamic Type sizes so the app feels native on iPhone. Text always respects the user's text-size setting.

motion.notes: Exits are faster than entrances. When the OS reduce-motion setting is on, every non-essential animation uses durationInstant or is skipped.

elevation.notes: Dark UI uses tonal surfaces plus a 1px border instead of drop shadows. Only floating sheets and the tab bar use a blur (sigma 20) over a 72% opaque background.
